claims.statement: In the Preview window, each change type can be placed in the primary or secondary location or ignored.
claims.supports: configure the location of each change type, primary or secondary, or ignore it

claims.statement: In the Preview window, individual changes can be removed from the migration scripts.
claims.supports: choose the changes that you want to remove from the migration scripts

claims.statement: For the changeSet or change under the caret, the inspector offers its dbms attribute as an editable choice among the known database types and a blank entry that clears it; the value need not be on the list.
claims.supports: LiquibaseDbmsItem options list with a null entry, not strict; LiquibaseDbmsDescriptor offers it only where the tag has a dbms attribute

claims.statement: The inspector offers the context attribute as an editable choice among the contexts already used in the project and a blank entry that clears it; free text is accepted.
claims.supports: LiquibaseContextItem collects contexts through the project searcher, null entry, not strict

claims.statement: The inspector offers the labels attribute as an editable choice among the labels already used in the project and a blank entry that clears it; free text is accepted.
claims.supports: LiquibaseLabelsItem collects labels through the project searcher, null entry, not strict

claims.statement: Boolean attributes of the selected tag (for a changeSet runAlways, runOnChange, failOnError and the like) are edited as true/false values written into the tag; a value equal to the schema default removes the attribute.
claims.supports: LiquibaseBooleanExpItem writes the attribute, or nothing when equal to the default; items come from the tag's schema attributes

claims.statement: Attributes with a fixed set of allowed values (such as onFail and onError of a precondition) are edited as a choice among exactly those values with a blank entry that clears the attribute.
claims.supports: LiquibaseOptionsItem built from the schema enumeration with a null entry; the tag loader creates one per enumerated attribute

claims.statement: The column type of a column element (type), of modifyDataType (newDataType) and of addNotNullConstraint (columnDataType) is edited as a choice among known data types, a blank entry clears it, and other text is accepted.
claims.supports: LiquibaseColumnTypeDescription maps these three tags to their type attribute; LiquibaseColumnTypeItem lists data types, not strict

claims.statement: Sequence-name attributes of the selected tag are edited as a choice among the sequence names known to the project; other text is accepted.
claims.supports: LiquibaseSequenceNameDescriptor/Item: options from the reference manager's sequence names, not strict

claims.statement: Clearing an inspector text value removes the attribute from the tag instead of writing an empty value.
claims.supports: LiquibaseAttributeValueItem.setValue_ writes null for an empty value or the default
claims.ourFeature: liquibase_inspector.rs (the remove-attribute choice of each Set action)

claims.statement: The inspector offers a delete action that removes the selected changelog tag and moves the caret to the next sibling tag, or to the end of the previous one.
claims.supports: DeleteTagAction deletes the selected PSI tag, then repositions the caret
claims.ourFeature: liquibase_inspector.rs (Remove this changeSet…, Remove this change…)

undocumented: no changelog inspector or structured change editor is described on the fetched pages
